question: Which of the following teams won the Indian Super League 2022-23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AKT Mohun Bagan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ATK Mohun Bagan **defeated Bengaluru FC in the final of the Indian Super League 2022-23 on penalties.**
 
• This was their **first-ever ISL title.** 
 
• ATK Mohun Bagan** finished at the top of the league** table during the regular season, showcasing their consistent performance and strong squad.
 
• The team displayed a high level of football in the playoffs, defeating strong opponents like Kerala Blasters FC and Bengaluru FC to reach the final.
 
• The** final against Bengaluru FC was decided by a penalty shootout, where ATK Mohun Bagan's goalkeeper, Amrinder Singh, made crucial saves to secure the victory **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** ** **Indian Super League 2022-23**

 
 
• **​**The **2022-23 Indian Super League (ISL)** season was the **9th edition** of India's premier football league. 
 
• The final was played on **March 18, 2023**, at the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, Goa.
 
 
 
• The top 4 teams that made it to the playoffs were:
 
 
• **Hyderabad FC** (Champions)
 
• **Kerala Blasters FC** (Runners-up)
 
• **Mumbai City FC**
 
• **ATK Mohun Bagan FC**
